newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Korea Development Bank to issue fifth global bond.
newsitem.headline: Korea Development Bank to issue fifth global bond.

text.p: The Korea Development Bank (KDB) intends to issue its fifth U.S. dollar global bond in the next few weeks, joint lead manager JP Morgan said in a statement on Thursday.
The proposed issue is expected to be US$500 million in size with "an intermediate maturity". Merrill Lynch and JP Morgan will jointly lead the deal.

The global bond will be the first sovereign South Korean benchmark bond issue since South Korea was invited to join the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) earlier this month.
The bonds are expected to be offered simultaneously in the North American, European and Asian markets.
Application to list the bonds on Hong Kong and Luxembourg Stock Exchanges will be made.
The issue is expected to trade globally through the integrated clearing system in the U.S and Euromarket, the statement said.
KDB is rated A1 by Moody's and AA minus by Standard and Poors.
